name: Rate-of-change relay
summary: Responds to how quickly a monitored quantity changes rather than only its absolute magnitude.
description: Responds to how quickly a monitored quantity changes rather than only its absolute magnitude.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the measured quantity and its engineering units. The associated drawing should trace the rate-sensitive alarm or trip output; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the measured quantity and its engineering units.

drawingChecklist: Label the measured quantity and its engineering units.

distinction: Device 7 is a general rate-of-change reference; 81R specifically denotes frequency rate of change in cited relay families.
